passages.title: / International Students' Satisfaction Survey
passages.text:
Greetings,
This survey aims to assess the level of academic and campus life satisfaction among international students, currently enrolled at Hanyang University.
The results of this survey will be utilized to create a better environment and infrastructure for international students.
Period : 2021.12.20.(Mon) ~ 2021.12.31.(Fri)
Who : International Students at HYU Survey link : http://isurvey.panel.co. kr/?Alias=5801231916 Gift: Starbucks Coupon (For the first 700 respondents)
- The survey consists of 50 questions and takes about 5~6 minutes.
- For the first 700 respondents who complete the survey, a “STARBUCKS Coffee Coupon” will be sent to you through your mobile phone. Please make sure to input your mobile number during the survey in order to receive the coupon.
- All personal information collected during the survey will solely be used for enhancing the study environment for international students. They will be discarded after the survey.
- For a better campus life, we kindly request your honest opinion.
Thank you for your participation!
Office of International Affairs (OIA), Hanyang University Seoul
